inputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.registered.value
inputs.description: The raw relay reply to a host registration, not yet trusted. It must be a non-array object whose `hostId` equals the `hostId` argument, with a safe non-negative integer `generation` and a non-empty string `registeredAt`; any other shape throws, and every field other than those three is dropped.
inputs.unknownReason: The relay response to registration is unchecked until the host identifier is verified.

inputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.registered.hostId
inputs.description: The host id the registration was made for, which the reply's `hostId` must equal exactly, with no trimming or case folding. The validator does not check its format; the relay's own host ids are 40 lowercase hex characters.

inputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.summary.value
inputs.description: The raw relay reply describing one remote host, before it is trusted. It must be a non-array object whose `hostId` equals the `hostId` argument, whose `devices` is an array, and whose `name` and `registeredAt` are non-empty strings, `online` is a boolean and `generation` is a safe non-negative integer, with each device entry an object carrying a non-empty `deviceId` and `createdAt`, a boolean `online` and a `lastSeenAt` that is null or a non-empty string; any other shape throws, and fields not listed here are dropped.
inputs.unknownReason: The relay host summary is external data validated at receive time.

inputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.summary.hostId
inputs.description: The host id being summarized, which the reply's `hostId` must equal exactly, with no trimming or case folding. It is copied unchanged into the result, and the validator does not check its format; the relay's own host ids are 40 lowercase hex characters.

inputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.done.value
inputs.description: The raw relay reply to a host unregister or device revoke, before it is trusted. It must be a non-array object whose `ok` is exactly `true`; any other value throws, and every field other than `ok` is dropped.
inputs.unknownReason: The relay completion reply must identify the requested host or device before acceptance.

outputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.registered
outputs.description: The validated registration result for one host, rebuilt from only `hostId`, `generation` and `registeredAt`. `hostId` is the id the caller asked for, `generation` is a safe non-negative integer, and `registeredAt` is a non-empty string that the relay writes as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

outputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.summary
outputs.description: The validated summary of one remote host, rebuilt field by field, with each device reduced to `deviceId`, `online`, `createdAt` and `lastSeenAt`. `devices` may be empty, and `lastSeenAt` is null for a device the relay has not yet recorded as seen, and otherwise a non-empty string that the relay writes as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

outputs.name: RelayReplyValidator.done
outputs.description: The acknowledgement returned once the relay reply has passed the `ok` check, always exactly `{ ok: true }` with no field copied from the reply.

errors.name: Relay response unavailable or invalid
errors.description: Thrown by `hubFail('unavailable')` whenever a check in any of the three operations fails, as an `Error` with the message 'Harness artifact unavailable' and `code` set to 'unavailable'. The error does not say which field failed.

errors.name: Invalid relay registration acknowledgment
errors.description: Thrown with `code` 'unavailable' when the value is not a non-array object, when its `hostId` differs from the `hostId` argument, when `generation` is not a safe non-negative integer, or when `registeredAt` is not a non-empty string.

errors.description: Thrown with `code` 'unavailable' when the value is not a non-array object, when its `hostId` differs from the `hostId` argument, when `devices` is not an array, or when `name`, `online`, `generation`, `registeredAt` or any device entry fails its check.
